_meta.what_this_is: A cohort of eight investment strategies (stand-ins for funds, models, A/B variants, users -- anything that can drop out) with their annual return in percent. A strategy 'survives' the period if it did not blow up: return above the survive_threshold. The ones below it were shut down and are missing from most datasets you would actually get your hands on. Survivorship bias: computing performance over only the survivors overstates it, because survival was CAUSED by having a good return -- the failures selected themselves out.
_meta.data_is: A FIXTURE. Returns are hand-authored; 'survived' is DERIVED from the threshold, so survivorship is endogenous to the outcome, exactly as in reality.
